name: Will Scharf
summary: Will Scharf became White House counsel on September 1, 2026, replacing David Warrington, after serving as staff secretary from the start of Trump’s second term. A former federal prosecutor from Missouri, he was one of Trump’s lawyers in his criminal cases and helped shape the presidential-immunity argument with John Sauer, and lost the 2024 Republican primary for Missouri attorney general to Andrew Bailey.
